text: VALDORIA, 9 October 2026. The Valdorian Ministry of Defence said it awarded Kestrel Dynamics a contract worth EUR 48 million for 30 counter-drone radar units. Kestrel Dynamics will deliver the first units in early 2028, the ministry added. A Kestrel Dynamics spokesperson denied that the company had received a second order from the Valdorian Navy. According to the trade newsletter Harbour Defence Weekly, Kestrel Dynamics may open a second assembly line in Ostrava, a report the company did not confirm. The radar was first tested in June 2025 at a range in northern Valdoria.
